beats.text: The most powerful man on Earth gave it all up, and wept.
Under his crown, Cortés destroyed the Aztec empire, and Pizarro the Inca. American silver began to pour into Spain.
On his twenty-fifth birthday, his army crushed the French at Pavia, and captured their king.
Francis the First was held in Madrid for a year. He signed a peace treaty, and broke it as soon as he was free.
Then Charles's own unpaid soldiers mutinied, and sacked Rome. The Pope hid in a fortress.
He beat the Protestant princes at Mühlberg. Titian painted him as the perfect Christian knight.
But the wars never ended, and neither did the debts. Worn out, he gave up his crowns, and wept in front of his court.
He retired to a small house beside a monastery in Spain, and died there in 1558.
beats.say: He retired to a small house beside a monastery in Spain, and died there in fifteen fifty-eight.

beats.text: His son Philip inherited the empire, and its debts.
